observations: Photo 0 shows a black Xbox console with a matching controller placed on top. The console has a textured black front panel with diagonal lines. The controller has standard Xbox buttons (A, B, X, Y) and a D-pad, analog stick, and two face buttons. The Xbox logo is visible on the bottom right of the console.

Photo 1 shows the same console from a side angle, revealing its slim profile and the same textured front panel. The console appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and smudges. The controller is not visible in this photo.
The console is placed on a wooden surface. There is a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GAME VILLAGE' on both photos.
No games, discs, or cables are visible in either photo.

claims.claim: Uk used Xbox console with games and one controller including FC, GTA, Mk
claims.evidence: No games or discs are visible in either photo. The controller is present but not shown in detail. The claim of 'FC, GTA, Mk' cannot be verified from the photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal damage
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, showing the Xbox dashboard and running a game.

risks.risk: Games or discs may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: Photos of the games and discs, or a video showing them being inserted and played.

risks.risk: Controller may not work or may be missing buttons or ports
risks.proof: Video of the controller connecting to the console and being used to play a game.
risks.if_unproven: priced as controller not included or not working

risks.risk: Console may have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, HDMI, power supply)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the disc drive, power cable, and HDMI port, and a video showing the console powering on and connecting to a TV.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and showing the Xbox dashboard.
Photos of the games and discs included.
Video of the controller connecting to the console and being used to play a game.
Close-up photos of the disc drive, power cable, and HDMI port.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
